column1: # F-1 calibration ledger, bank-failure family (DAEDALUS F-1; built 2026-11-26 by ORACLE live session, prome-80 wake). One row per RESOLVED Polymarket instance with a pre-resolution read in workbook/ODDS_LOG.tsv. p = Gamma yes_prob at the LAST logged read before close (no CLOB backfill). Brier = (p - outcome)^2. LIMITS: n=5; every book under $5K liq except the monthly July contract (thin rule: none of these was ever marked); outcomes are not independent (one FDIC failure resolves two instances on 7/10); the any-bank instances resolve at the failure, so 'last read before close' is a different horizon per row (h_days). This is a diagnostic of crowd accuracy, not a forecast score of ORACLE. Named-bank event legs (which-banks-will-fail-*) are excluded: dozens of near-zero NO legs would flatter the mean.
